The sentence is conditional on a positive control (synthetic BT on the Arena-55k graph with known overdispersion / position bias / cycles, Δ computed as for real data), requested from experiment-repo in experiment-repo#9, plus an SE-ratio summary (cluster-bootstrap over model-based SE, real vs null), which is where misfit would show. Until #9 is answered write: "the count per unit gap/g_max is within the margin of the same-graph null in these instances", and state that whether Δ can detect misfit was not (yet) tested; when the control is in, say what it shows. Name those rows rather than all of MT-Bench and all small seasons (MT-Bench flip is equivalent).
3. **C2 framing.** "Random noise ... essentially never reverses" is the noise formula P_flip(f) = Φ(−z√((1−f)/f)) expectation (below 1e-4 for f<1%, z≥1), confirmed on real data; say so with measured next to formula (analysis owner was asked for a few values). The informative number is f_q/f, a lower bound where random never reaches q. Otherwise a reviewer who knows the formula finds it trivial.
4. **C3 range (abstract (b), Findings (b)).** "a few tenths of a percent": for the median crowd data set the survival is 0.64 at 0.25 % of N and 0.04 at 1.2 %; say "a few tenths of a percent to about one percent" (or quote the two numbers). PR #13 is merged into `main`, and I've asked `internal-review-repo` to review the new head of the release PR #11.

- **PR #13:** `figtab-repo` approved it, and I merged it with a merge commit; `main` is now 9376bc1. The abstract and introduction rewrite and Fig. 6 are in, along with the starter-item wording that says not reading it was our choice. `paper/` is mine, so no one else needed to approve it.
- **PR #11 (`main` into `release`):** its head moved to 9376bc1. I commented that both of `internal-review-repo`'s required changes are answered at the new head, and asked for a re-review.
- **`paper-repo`#7:** I closed it. `story-repo` found nothing open after the earlier fixes, and the comment lists its places as in the text.
- **`dev`:** I merged `main` into `dev` and pushed, so the two stay aligned.
- **Builds:** the system's `main` build still shows the old commit 532f793, so I haven't yet checked the new build. The `dev` build from 8fbed34 has 29 pages and no Type 3 fonts.
- **Starter paper not read:** it stays unread unless `internal-review-repo` says in the PR thread that reading it is permitted and which part to read.
- **Arena control:** its cells are still partial, and only the no-departure cell is quoted. They will be added once `experiment-repo` marks them complete.

I'm now waiting on `internal-review-repo`'s review of #11.
